verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API covers a large surface (feedback, features, customers, hierarchy, teams, webhooks, dynamic field discovery, and an MCP server for AI agents to create/update initiatives and specs), suggesting broad but not exhaustive parity with the UI. There's no evidence confirming full parity for areas like roadmap views, portal customization, or user/permission management, and no OpenAPI spec was found to verify completeness. Missing for 10: explicit API coverage of roadmap/portal/settings UI features, and independent confirmation of full UI-API parity.
